name: AppsFlyer Android SDK

dataTypes.when: Always: the IP address is received and mapped to region/city level. Precise location is not collected.
Always: AppsFlyer measures app launches by default, which it says 'may be deemed page views or other actions'. If you log in-app events, also consider App activity / Other actions.
Always per AppsFlyer's default-configuration table (e.g. launch time or battery level for fraud detection).

dataTypes.type: App info and performance / Other app performance data
Device or other IDs / Device or other IDs
dataTypes.when: By default the Android SDK collects the Google Advertising ID (GAID). Not collected if you remove the AD_ID permission and call setDisableAdvertisingIdentifiers.

ask: Do you send attribution data to ad networks or other partners (postbacks, SRN integrations, audiences)? AppsFlyer says that counts as sharing: if yes, mark these data types as shared with purpose Advertising or marketing.
Do you measure in-app purchases with AppsFlyer? If yes, declare Financial info / Purchase history.
Do you log custom in-app events? If yes, declare App activity / Other actions (or App interactions) for those events.
Do you set a Customer User ID (setCustomerUserId) or send hashed emails / phone numbers? If yes, declare Personal info / User IDs, Email address and/or Phone number as applicable.
Do you use the data for app features, notifications, personalization or account management? AppsFlyer only pre-answers Analytics and Fraud prevention; add the other purposes that apply.

sources.title: Fill out Google safety section form (AppsFlyer Help Center, updated 2026-10-14)

notes: AppsFlyer says it 'acts solely as a service provider on your behalf', so default data is collected but not shared; sharing arises only from partner integrations you configure. AppsFlyer says data is not processed ephemerally, is encrypted in transit, and can be deleted via its OpenGDPR framework. The help-center page blocks automated fetches; content was read via the Zendesk Help Center API for the same article (updated_at 2026-10-14).
